messages.content:

Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: Open-source agent frameworks hit a major production milestone as adoption triples, while model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups. Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models. Meanwhile, multi-agent swarms are moving from early demos to regulated enterprise workflows, and new observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end across the tech sector.
